title: Monitoring exclusions and system status
summary: Choose which users Jellydash monitors and check whether background workers are running. This release also corrects viewing-time tracking and fixes history imports, notification retries and remembered login.
highlights: Manage Monitoring, Notifications and Statistics exclusions together in Settings. Environment values remain available as fallbacks.
Hide existing activity for excluded users and skip new collection and imports. Earlier rows stay in the database if you remove an exclusion later.
Check background worker status from the sidebar or Settings, and copy diagnostics for troubleshooting.
Measure viewing time going forward and label older playback-position totals as estimates.
Preserve native History restore data, retry failed notifications and handle concurrent remembered-login requests.
